page_title: BAY 4-0 WER | Bayern Munich v Werder Bremen 26/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
87' 4 - 0 Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
86' The attendance is 75000.
86' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
84' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Wisdom Mike (Bayern Munich) replaces Luis Diaz.

83' This shall not pass! Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bayern Munich are going to take it.

83' Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Karl Hein to get hold of the ball.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuel Mbangula trots off the pitch and is replaced by Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen).
80' Horst Steffen has decided to substitute Felix Agu and he is replaced by Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen).
80' Substitution. Jens Stage makes way for Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
79' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
79' A dangerous looking corner kick from Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is cleared to safety by the defence.
78' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) replacing Michael Olise.
78' Substitution. Harry Kane will be replaced by Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich).

77' A great solo run by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort low towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Karl Hein. Now Bayern Munich have a corner.
77' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
75' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the right post by a whisker.
73' Justin Njinmah goes off the pitch and Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) comes on.
71' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

68' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) gets on the end of a cross inside the box and sweeps the ball goalwards low towards the middle of the goal, but Manuel Neuer is well positioned and easily deals with the effort.
67' The ball goes behind for a corner. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
65' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
65' 3 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 3:0. He was ably assisted there by Luis Diaz.
63' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
61' Serge Gnabry will be replaced by Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich).
61' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) replaces Leon Goretzka.
61' Substitution. Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Cameron Puertas walks off.
58' Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
54' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top.
51' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
48' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

45+3' That's unlucky! Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Corner kick. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity.

45+2' A neat pass finds Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Karl Hein denies him with a good save.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' 2 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Karl Hein to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
45' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
44' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Frank Willenborg signals. Bayern Munich are awarded a penalty!

41' Karl Hein makes a good save! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.
39' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
38' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
35' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) tries to find Luis Diaz, but he puts too much power on the pass.
32' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
30' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
30' Frank Willenborg blows the whistle, Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is penalised for a foul. Werder Bremen are awarded the free kick.
26' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Karl Hein anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
22' 1 - 0 What a goal! Michael Olise swings a cross into the box and Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) scores a magnificent back-heel goal! 1:0.
22' The resulting corner from Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is cleared.
19' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
16' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
16' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
14' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
14' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
10' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
8' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the left post.
6' Frank Willenborg couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) and blew his whistle.
5' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.
3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) latches onto a short pass from Michael Olise inside the box, but clips his shot well wide of the right post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Bayern Munich will kick the game off.
Frank Willenborg will officiate today.
